purpose: Exhaustive retrospective contact-pass subsets crossed with uniform calibration-grid densities and pooled evaluation subsets
gridNotation: rows x columns; vertical x horizontal; exact uniform original coordinates including boundaries
aggregation: Componentwise median of selected passes at each retained coordinate, identical to existing A. Two passes give their arithmetic mean; three give the coordinatewise median.
method: Existing A bilinear magnetic forward surface and fixed 181x181 inverse-position search. No kNN or neural network.
background: Training uses existing per-row before/after linear correction. Every test query is its steady raw median minus preceding row background only.
fixedDisplayParameters: Reuse each training subset's already frozen A model constants across all densities. Legacy residual thresholds were derived from all 273 positions in those training passes; main ungated spatial metrics do not depend on them.
evaluationPooling: Concatenate all 273 placements in every selected evaluation pass. No vector averaging across test passes; compute quantiles and rates from pooled predictions, not averaged summary quantiles.

roles.held_out_only: Training and evaluation pass sets are disjoint.
roles.same_pass_only: Every evaluation pass was used in training; includes retained anchors and other coordinates from the same sessions.
roles.mixed: Evaluation includes both training and unseen passes. Never call this held-out accuracy.

selectionPolicy: Retain all 7 x 25 x 7 = 1225 results. Report best mean-error and best 2.5mm-rate models separately within the same held-out evaluation set. Also compare each single-pass fit on both other passes and report fixed-density matched-test folds.
limitations: Three previously inspected contact passes, fixed phi=0/theta=90/alpha=0/height=0mm; no posture or air generalization claims.
Choosing a best condition after examining these results is exploratory selection, not a fresh validation claim.
The 1+2+3 training subset has no held-out pass available. Evaluation on 1+2+3 always contains training data.
9/15/24/77/273 main grids were selected in the previous experiment. Only 24->77->273 form a nested isotropic sequence.
Pass2 acquisition caveats remain; do not omit it based on evaluation scores.
